data.completion_memo: Implemented runtime completion barriers and job notices in ordinary, approval-aware and approval-resume model-loop paths. Consecutive ignored reminders are bounded and request unretained-job cleanup. User Stop reaches Chat jobs even while awaiting approval; active jobs bind to the next owning pass. Text-only deferred responses preserve exact history and all provider wire formats avoid invented or empty tool results. Validation: all 345 desktop library tests passed, then the additional restart-output regression passed (4 registry tests total); all 9 model-loop tests passed, including approval-resume and refusal bounds; 5 provider-context wire tests passed; native Windows shell/session tests passed (7 non-ignored tests, plus network 2 passed/1 ignored). Final native Chat test passed: 11 mock-provider requests through real WebView/UI, approval resume, premature completion rejected, stdin delivery, retention, ordinary shell soft wait, concurrent jobs, two verified empty process trees, no project. Evidence: desktop/src-tauri/target/native-shell-jobs-1789663752860/{requests.json,verified.png}. Frontend typecheck and Vite build passed; Rust build/check and diff check passed. Platform crate strict Clippy passed. Repository-wide strict Clippy remains blocked by pre-existing large-error, style and other lints outside this scope; new-module actionable style findings were corrected. Windows is natively verified; Unix process-group implementation was not exercised on this host. The live user app was not restarted; enable/bind job tools in a new Chat after restarting the rebuilt app. Adashi QA jobs were not changed.
data.description: Integrate job notices and final-answer checks in all model loop paths, including resume; nudge collection, wait, stop or explicitly approved handover. User Stop remains responsive and cancels jobs. Verify actual native Windows Chat tool flow, long commands, interactive input, descendants, owner isolation, restart behavior, no popup and final-answer guard; document the user-facing contract.
data.title: Enforce outstanding-job completion checks and verify native Chat workflow
